description: Generate one music track through the MiniMax Mavis gateway: an instrumental track from a style prompt, or a song when lyrics are supplied. Generation is non-idempotent and consumes quota, so a disconnected call is an uncertain failure that must not be resent blindly.

prompt.description: Music style and scene description, 10-300 characters after trimming.

lyrics.description: Optional lyrics, 10-600 characters after trimming. Omit for an instrumental track.

format.description: Audio container format; defaults to mp3.

sample_rate.description: Sample rate in Hz; one of 16000, 24000, 32000, 44100.
